<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">PointDataSource</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Point data source allows the rendering engine access to the user provided
 geographical locations and their attributes.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behavior. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
</li>
</ul>

<a id="forEach(com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource.PointDataSource.PointDataProcessor)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>forEach</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;forEach&#8203;(@NonNull
                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-pointdatasource-pointdataprocessor" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource">PointDataSource.PointDataProcessor</a>&nbsp;processor)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Iterates through all the points from the data source and passes them to the
 given processor, one by one. The processor can update the point data.
 <p>The iteration stops after all points have been processed or the processor returns false
 from the process call.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>processor</code> - <p>Point data processor.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<li class="blockList">

<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;removeIf&#8203;(@NonNull
                     <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-pointdatasource-pointdataprocessor" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource">PointDataSource.PointDataProcessor</a>&nbsp;processor)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Iterates through all the points from the data source and passes them to the
 given inspector, one by one. All points for which the inspector returns <code>true</code> get removed from the data source.
 The inspector cannot update the point data.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>processor</code> - <p>Point data processor.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
